scope: 15 exact registry packages for disposable Rust probe; source code and Cargo.lock published, dependency implementations and binaries not published. Not a production dependency or release approval.
limitations: Declared licenses and notice presence reviewed; no security audit, maintainer availability certification or transitive unsafe-code audit.
Package SHA-256 agrees with Cargo.lock and cached registry archives; this is identity/integrity evidence, not an independent author-authentication proof.
